jobicy163134.title: AI Researcher
jobicy163134.description: Hume AI is seeking talented AI researchers interested in working with our team to build state-of-the-art speech-language models (SLMs). Our new SLM training method—reinforcement learning from human expression (RLHE)—learns human preferences from behavior in millions of audio and video recordings, making SLMs superhumanly helpful, interesting, funny, eloquent, honest, and altruistic. Join us in the heart of New York City and contribute to our endeavor to ensure that AI is guided by human values, the most pivotal challenge (and opportunity) of the 21st century. About Us Hume AI is a Series B startup dedicated to building artificial intelligence that is directly optimized for human well-being. As the first company to release speech language models, we’re focused on expanding our research to encompass audio understanding models and evaluation platforms for enterprises. Our goal is to enable a future in which technology draws on an understanding of human emotional expression to better serve human goals. As part of our mission, we also conduct groundbreaking scientific research, publish in leading scientific journals like Nature , and support a non-profit, The Hume Initiative, that has released the first concrete ethical guidelines for empathic AI ( www.thehumeinitiative.org ). You can learn more about us on our website ( https://hume.ai/ ) and read about us in WIRED , Forbes , and Venturebeat . About the Role We are looking for talented researchers with relevant publications, 2+ years of experience in a research role in industry, and/or a proven track record of contributions to open source language, audio, or video models. (A PhD is neither necessary nor sufficient.) We're looking for someone excited to work with our team to build state-of-the-art audio models and evaluation tools. In this role, you will build out software systems that support distributed model training, inference, and benchmarking as well as massive-scale data collection, storage, preprocessing, and analysis. You will be working to solve some of today’s most exciting AI research problems at industry scale. Requirements Expertise in the Python ecosystem and popular ML libraries and tools (e.g. PyTorch) Experience writing robust and maintainable production-ready code Comfort iterating quickly on new and uncertain research directions 2+ years of experience contributing to the training and/or fine-tuning of models with large-scale datasets of text, audio, image, and/or video data (predictive or generative) Application Note Please apply only to the position that best aligns with your qualifications. If you submit multiple applications or have applied within the past 6 months, only your initial submission will be considered. Annual Salary $180,000—$350,000 USD

jobicy163126.description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. Collaborate closely with MLOps and Backend Engineering to operationalise models end-to-end and raise the bar on ML lifecycle rigor. jobicy163073.title: Senior Product Designer, Mobile
jobicy163073.description: About Us: Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home. We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us. About the Role: This is an early-stage app with huge expansion planned this year — a rare opportunity for a designer who wants to define the vision for a mobile product from the ground up. As Senior Product Designer, you will define how AI feels for the teams building our homes. You'll shape the experiences that our Superintendents and Direct Construction Operators (DCOs) rely on every day—across our mobile application, advanced AI based video analysis, and new experiences around automated data capture on site. This is a role for a designer who blends sharp interaction design with strong visual craft. You'll take novel, sometimes ambiguous AI capabilities—computer vision, multimodal models, agents—and turn them into interfaces that feel clear, trustworthy, and genuinely delightful on a jobsite. You know the emerging patterns for designing with AI (surfacing confidence, handling uncertainty, guiding and correcting the model) and you have a point of view on how to make them feel effortless for users who are not sitting at a desk. You're also an exceptional communicator: helping craft executive level presentations that carry Homebound's AI narrative across the entire company, our board, and our investors. What You'll Do: Own the end-to-end experience: Design interaction flows and polished, high-craft visuals across all of our field initiatives. Design compelling AI patterns: Turn frontier AI capabilities into interfaces that are clear and trustworthy—handling confidence, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop correction in delightful ways. Design for the field, not the desk: Craft mobile-first experiences that work for Superintendents and DCOs in real jobsite conditions. Bring experiences to life with motion: Use motion design where it counts to make AI interactions feel intuitive, responsive, and compelling. Partner tightly with your PM and engineers: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Field AI PM and Engineering to move from concept to shipped product. Communicate the AI story: Present to executives and teams across the company, using your work to make Homebound's AI vision tangible and shared. What You'll Bring: A portfolio showcasing highly polished mobile app case studies, demonstrating strong interaction design and high visual craft. 5+ years of product design experience, with direct experience designing mobile applications (iOS strongly preferred). Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML patterns into products in delightful, usable ways. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, including direct experience presenting to executive-level audiences. Comfort designing in ambiguity—translating novel, evolving AI capabilities into clear, intuitive experiences. A collaborative, self-starting approach; you partner naturally across product, engineering, and operations. Interest in construction and the built environment is a plus; no prior industry experience required, but an expectation to learn the domain rapidly. Our Commitment : We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page. Homebound is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Homebound considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our Compensation Philosophy : Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that each job posting includes a general description of any other compensation offered for the position in addition to the salary range displayed on the job posting. dioqaenglishus.title: Crux - Video and Audio QA - English (US)
dioqaenglishus.description: Overview We are hiring Quality Control (QC) evaluators for a project that spans both Search and Linguistic tasks. You will perform quality checks on initial ratings produced by evaluators—validating user intent assessment, query annotation, text classification, and multimedia (video, image, audio) reviews for relevanc, accuracy, and guideline adherence. The ideal candidate combines strong language skills with sharp analytical judgment, excellent documentation and feedback skills, and familiarity with short-form video culture. What you will do Audit samples of initial ratings for relevance, intent alignment, taxonomy compliance, and linguistic quality. Re-rate items (double-scoring) to verify labels; resolve discrepancies and document decisions. Perform linguistic quality checks (grammar, tone, clarity, local relevance) and media comprehension reviews. Classify and track errors using an agreed error taxonomy; surface trends and edge cases. Provide clear, actionable feedback to evaluators; contribute to guideline clarifications and updates. Participate in and lead calibration sessions to drive inter-rater agreement. Track and report QC metrics (e.g., agreement rates, accuracy, error trends) and meet QC SLAs. Triage escalations, handle ambiguous cases, and ensure data integrity and compliance. Use internal tools to complete, track, and submit QC tasks accurately. Project Details Engagement Type: Freelance Rate: USD 28.61/hour Estimated Hours: 15-30 hours/week Requirement Native or near-native speaker level in English language with strong reading, writing, and listening comprehension. Excellent grammar, writing, and proofreading skills. Strong video and image comprehension; good hearing ability for audio tasks. Solid understanding of search engines, user intent, and web content. High attention to detail, consistency, and guideline adherence. Ability to deliver clear written feedback and rationale. Preferred qualifications Experience in QC/QA for text classification, query annotation, data labeling, or search quality evaluation. Familiarity with short dramas and local short-drama culture/platforms. Experience with calibrations, sampling, scorecards, and root-cause analysis. Comfortable working with productivity and quality targets; proficient with spreadsheets/QA tools. Background in linguistics, communications, media studies, information science, or related field. creatoryoutube.title: Content Creator - Youtube
creatoryoutube.description: Headquarters: Switzerland URL: https://meticsmedia.com Job Overview Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media. About us Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them. We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone. We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world. What you'll do Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way. Write video scripts and outlines. Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos. Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor. What we're looking for Native-level written and spoken English Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work Ability to take feedback and continuously improve Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada Nice to have Previous experience creating educational video content Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos Working at Metics Media At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work. At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos. Compensation Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US based), $80,000 CAD per year (Canada based) Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly For reference, our current US-based creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed. How to apply Please submit your application on our website: https://join.meticsmedia.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/metics-media-content-creator-youtube

jobicy163171.title: Lead Creative (Motion Design)
jobicy163171.description: Superside is looking for a Lead Creative (Motion Design) to push the boundaries of what’s possible in motion and animation. In this role, you’ll lead a global team of top-tier creatives, delivering world-class motion graphics, digital ads, explainer videos, promos, animated presentations, and more. You’ll shape creative strategy, inspire your team, and partner with leading global brands to deliver impactful work that blends craft, innovation, and cutting-edge technology. What You'll Do Lead and inspire a team of motion designers, driving creative excellence and innovation across projects. Own the creative strategy, workflow, and delivery of multiple projects, ensuring quality, timeliness, and budget alignment. Collaborate with your dedicated account teams to successfully grow and develop our customers Partner directly with global brands, presenting work and building trust through outstanding creative direction. Mentor and develop your team, fostering growth, skill development, and collaboration. Champion the adoption of new tools and technologies, including AI, to elevate motion design processes and outputs. What you will need to succeed BA or higher within Design, Creative, Comms, or similar fields. 6+ years of experience as a world-class creative lead in an international top-tier creative agency or in-house design team in a global tech company Strong portfolio of creative work in Motion Design. Experience leading high-performing creative teams, managing end-to-end creative projects. Deep expertise in Adobe After Effects and Premiere; strong animation and video editing skills. Solid understanding of AI-assisted design and motion workflows (e.g. MidJourney, Runway, Krea etc), with a track record of integrating AI tools into creative pipelines to enhance ideation, production, and delivery. Ability to quickly learn processes and multi-task projects with great detail. Ability to always deliver pixel-perfect quality on time and within budget Excellent English verbal and written communication skills. A proactive, customer-centric mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Compensation Additional Information Why Join us? Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are. Remote-first. Customer-led. Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones. Global team, local impact. Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands. High performance, low ego. Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration. Impact meets opportunity. We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here. Grow fast. Lead well. You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry. About Superside Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones. Learn more at superside.com Diversity, Equity and Inclusion We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobicy163938.title: Staff Technical Writer
jobicy163938.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. As a Staff Technical Writer at GitLab, you’ll shape how users, and the AI agents working on their behalf, understand, adopt, and succeed with GitLab. You’ll partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and UX researchers to turn features and design decisions into clear, scalable documentation and intuitive UI text across multiple product stages and sections. As AI increasingly drafts and reviews our content, you’ll bring the judgement that upholds quality and the system thinking that scales that judgement across our documentation. When you see the same problem repeating, you’ll fix the cause rather than just the page, whether that’s through a style guide update, a lint rule, or an AI skill. You’ll model effective use of AI, lead improvements to our docs site and processes, and contribute to one of the world’s largest open-source projects while engaging with our wider community. What you’ll do Own and maintain documentation across product areas (which GitLab organizes by engineering stages and sections), driving improvements and balancing priorities. Champion AI best practices by modeling approved tool use, establishing governance and quality checks, and integrating AI workflows that improve efficiency and quality. Lead efforts to improve the product user experience through UI text, creating model examples and improving the style guide. Design scalable information architecture and content types optimized for both human readability and AI retrieval. Model review practices that improve the quality of contributions and feed back into AI review flows. Design and lead process improvements. Identify systemic problems and the most efficient solution, building alignment with stakeholders and driving adoption. Partner with engineers to translate documentation, content-quality, and user needs into improvements to documentation systems and docs-site functionality. Use data to prioritize work, measure impact, and establish team KPIs. Lead large cross-stage content initiatives, driving collaboration across functions to achieve shared customer and company outcomes. Address feedback from internal teams, customers, support, and community contributors, identifying patterns for wider improvements. Act as a thought partner to management on technical and project decisions, and act as primary lead for a specialist domain such as AI, UX writing, metrics, or tooling. Mentor technical writers and team members on best practices and prioritization. What you’ll bring End-to-end expertise in planning, researching, writing, and editing software documentation. UX and content design skills, with a track record of refining interface text, labels, and naming conventions to improve the product user experience. Experience designing and using AI workflows, including evaluating and refining AI-generated output and guiding quality checks for others. Proficiency working in a docs-as-code environment, using the same workflows and tooling as engineering, operations, and product teams. Fluency using the Linux shell and command-line Git, coupled with general familiarity with one or more programming languages. Excellent grammar, minimalist documentation design skills, and effective information architecture. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to triage and prioritize numerous issues and projects across stages and sections. A track record of leading cross-team projects and process improvements, building alignment with stakeholders, and driving adoption. Data-driven decision making, using analytics and feedback to guide content strategy and demonstrate impact. The ability to succeed in a remote, globally distributed environment, including collaborating across countries and time zones, and to model respectful, professional communication. Adaptability and readiness to work in a rapidly changing environment. Familiarity with DevSecOps tools and open-source software is helpful, not required. About the team Our technical writing team works at the intersection of product, engineering, design, and marketing. We define how GitLab’s features are communicated across documentation and UI text, and we influence product direction by bringing a deep understanding of how words shape user success in a rapidly evolving DevSecOps platform. We also manage the systems that ensure quality at scale, from the governance and orchestration of AI workflows to deterministic testing and linting. Guided by GitLab’s operating principles, we work in a globally distributed, remote-first environment where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter.
